title: Tourism Explorer
description: Find tourist attractions near a destination and filter them by type.

supportedIntents.description: Queries requesting attractions, landmarks, museums, parks, or other places to visit near a destination.
example: What parks can I visit in San Francisco?

categories.description: Types of tourist attractions, such as museums, monuments, temples, forts, parks, and viewpoints.

subtypes.description: Specific attraction subtypes, such as historic sites, gardens, galleries, or castles.

attributes.description: Attraction details such as name, address, category, coordinates, website, or distance.

minMaxRange.description: Distance range in kilometers from the requested destination.

schema.description: Tourism query describing the destination and the attractions to find.

type.description: Request type: 'list' for nearby attractions or 'query' for a filtered search.

filters.description: Filters to narrow down attractions by destination, category, subtype, or search radius.

name.description: Name of a specific attraction, if requested.

destination.description: City or destination where attractions should be found.

radiusKm.description: Search radius in kilometers around the destination.
